caption: Sunlight warms a greenhouse in the morning, and the inside of its glass panes is covered in drops that begin to run down.

sa.check: The inside of the panes is covered in drops.
The drops begin to run down.
The drops merge into streaks as they run.
The setting is a sunlit morning.

pc.expect: The drops merge and run downward on the inner face of the glass and gather along the lower rails.
pc.fail: A drop runs up a pane; or a streak travels sideways and stays level; or water gathers along a pane's top rail and stays; or a drop leaves the glass and rises.

pc.expect: The drops only merge, run and clear from the glass; the panes do not bead up again while the house warms.
pc.fail: A pane that has cleared beads up again with nothing cooling it; or the drops grow and shrink in turn; or the streaks retreat up the glass; or the panes fog harder as the sun rises on them.

pc.expect: The water lies on the inside of the panes and the plants and soil below are damp.
pc.fail: The drops lie on the outer face while the inner face is dry; or the panes run with water while the soil and plants inside are bone dry and dusty; or the drops appear on the frame and not on the glass.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on glass: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the glass stays rigid and clear.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the pane; or the water sets as frost in the warming house; or the glass flexes as the water runs.

pc.expect: The greenhouse keeps its panes and frame and nothing passes through the glass.
pc.fail: A pane vanishes; or a new pane appears; or water passes through the glass to the outside; or the frame changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The frame, the plants and the paths stay the same.
pc.fail: The frame changes colour; or the plants change into different plants; or the paths change pattern.
